ui.extra.cacheClean:
1. Confirm whether the wish history in the game has been opened, and if the error "User authentication expired" still appears, try the following steps 
2. Close the game window of Genshin Impact 
3. Click the "Open Web Cache Folder" button above to open the "Cache" folder 
4. Delete the "Cache_ Data" folder 
5. Start the Genshin Impact game and open the wish history page in the game 
6. Close this dialog and click the "Update Data" button
ui.extra.findCacheFolder: If the "Open cache folder" button does not respond, you can manually find the game's web cache folder. The directory is "Your game installation path/Genshin Impact Game/GenshinImpact_Data/webCaches/Cache/"

ui.analysis.fortune.note: Uses the community rate model and the community's reading of Capturing Radiance (75% after 2 losses in a row, 100% after 3). Worst/best banner are picked by pulls spent beyond (or below) what their rate-ups should cost; the tier is that banner's own efficiency. Tiers: top 5% Blessed, 5–25% Lucky, 25–75% Average, 75–95% Unlucky, bottom 5% Cursed.

ui.analysis.collection.hint: Constellation = copies − 1 (including losses, the standard and chronicled wishes, and copies you record under Other sources). Pulls = what each rate-up copy cost, including the 5★ lost before its guarantee; other copies add to the constellation only. Gifts and exchanges aren't in the wish history, so record them with + on the card.
